description: This file defines an interface and its implementation for storing MCP (Mesh Configuration Protocol) server configurations, primarily using a YAML file. It includes data structures and methods to load, save, delete, list, and update configurations for MCP servers within a project.

classes.name: YAMLConfigStorage
classes.description: Implementation of ConfigStorage that persists MCP server configurations in a YAML file.

classes.name: agentfieldYAML
classes.description: Struct representing the structure of agentfield.yaml, focusing on dependencies.mcp_servers.

methods.name: NewYAMLConfigStorage
methods.description: Constructor for YAMLConfigStorage, initializes with project directory.

methods.name: loadAgentFieldYAML
methods.description: Internal method to read and unmarshal agentfield.yaml into a structured object.

methods.name: saveAgentFieldYAML
methods.description: Internal method to marshal and write the agentfieldYAML structure back to file.

methods.name: LoadMCPServerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific MCP server by alias.

methods.name: SaveMCPServerConfig
methods.description: Saves or updates the configuration for a specific MCP server.

methods.name: DeleteMCPServerConfig
methods.description: Deletes configuration for a specific MCP server.

methods.name: LoadAllMCPServerConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves all stored MCP server configurations.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Atomically updates a configuration using a provided update function.

methods.name: ListMCPServerAliases
methods.description: Returns all MCP server aliases currently stored.
